LAYER 01 // OPTICS

Double-Domed Sapphire Crystal

Synthetic corundum with hardness rating 9 on the Mohs scale. Dual-sided vacuum anti-reflective treatment eliminating 99.4% of optical surface glare.

LAYER 02 // VISUAL ARRAY

3,000-Nit Ultra-Retina MicroLED

410 pixels per inch with 100% DCI-P3 color gamut coverage. Dynamic variable refresh rate from 1Hz always-on to 120Hz smooth kinetic sweeping.

LAYER 03 // SILICON

K1 California Neural Architecture

Designed in Cupertino. 3nm System-in-Package featuring dedicated biometric co-processors running continuous local neural sleep and cardiac telemetry.

LAYER 04 // POWER CELL

Solid-State Electrolyte Battery

Breakthrough 540mAh energy density cell providing 72 hours of unthrottled performance with fast induction charging (0 to 80% in 28 minutes).

LAYER 05 // METALLURGY

Grade 5 Titanium Monobloc Chassis

Precision CNC-milled from a single block of Ti-6Al-4V aerospace alloy. Twice the tensile strength of aluminum at half the weight of surgical steel.

LAYER 06 // BIOMETRICS

Hexagonal PPG Optical Ring

8-photodiode optical cluster emitting green, red, and infrared wavelengths for clinical-grade ECG recording, blood oxygen saturation, and autonomic recovery.
